connection_gate.forbidden_body: This server only admits devices on its tailnet. Connect from a device on the server's tailnet, then try again.
connection_gate.not_admin_title: This device can't open taproot yet
connection_gate.not_admin_body_unnamed: This device has no access to the dashboard. On a device that is already an admin, open Access and turn on Admin for it.
connection_gate.request_title: This device doesn't have access yet.
connection_gate.request_sent: Request sent. You'll have access once the server's admin allows it.
connection_gate.request_rate_limited: Too many requests from this device. Try again in {{minutes}} minutes.
connection_gate.request_failed: The request didn't go through. Try again.
connection_gate.unreachable_body: The management API did not answer. Check that the server is running.
connection_gate.claim_body: Enter the setup code from taproot's log. This device, {{node}}, will become the first admin and can use the proxy. You can add your other devices after.
connection_gate.claim_hint: To find the code, run {{command}} on the server, or read taproot's service log, and look for "setup code". It works once, and taproot makes a new one each time it restarts.
connection_gate.claim_wrong_code: That isn't the setup code. Check the newest "setup code" line in taproot's log.
connection_gate.claim_rate_limited: Too many wrong codes. Try again in {{seconds}} seconds.
connection_gate.claim_taken: Another device has already claimed this server. Ask its admin to turn on Admin for this device on the Access page.
connection_gate.claim_failed: The claim didn't go through. Check that the server is running, then try again.
